series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

ndc_assessment.vintage: First (I)NDC round, as assessed by WRI CAIT (2016). Not the latest submission.
ndc_assessment.summary: Please note that the INDC was submitted only in Spanish. WRI did its best to translate the INDC language. If any errors are identified, please contact us at ClimateWatch@WRI.org "Reducción de un 15% de las emisiones respecto al escenario BAU para el 2030 para el conjunto de sectores contenido en este escenario BAU. Este compromiso está condicionado a que el apoyo sea favorable, previsible y se viabilicen los mecanismos de financiamiento climático. Adicionalmente, la República de Honduras se compromete, como objetivo sectorial, a la forestación/reforestación de 1 millón de hectáreas de bosque antes de 2030. Asimismo, a través de la NAMA de fogones eficientes se espera reducir en un 39% el consumo de leña en las familias, ayudando en la lucha contra la deforestación." A 15% emissions reduction relative to BAU levels in 2030 for all sectors included in this BAU scenario. This commitment is conditional upon favorable and predictable support and available climate financing mechanisms. Additionally, the Republic of Honduras is committed, as a sectoral target, to the afforestation / reforestation of 1 million hectares of forests by 2030. Moreover, through the efficient stoves NAMA, a 39% reduction in family firewood consumption is expected, helping in the fight against deforestation.
ndc_assessment.ghg_target: 15% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario

verdict.text: The registry's current submission for this Party is NDC 3.0, filed 2026-01-21. 50 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (4). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-35 34.5 MtCO₂e, DS-02 22.8 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. No implementation gap is reported: 35 observed years are loaded, but no NDC target emissions figure has been parsed, so there is nothing to measure the trend against. It submitted BTR1. 3 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 41.3 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: 15% reduction in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to the BAU scenario It was classed conditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.12°C under SSP1-2.6 to +4.27°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
